name: Adwaita 24H Lockscreen Clock & Weather
description: Replaces the default lock screen clock with a customizable Libadwaita 24H/12H hybrid analog-digital clock, exact live preview across all settings pages, interactive country/city database, weekday strip, system theme/accent color integration, world numeral systems, and regional multi-calendar support. Uses unlock-dialog session mode to render on the lock screen shield, and queries Open-Meteo, ipwho.is, and BigDataCloud APIs.
